::: {.callout-note}
## This chapter moved to [Plugins](plugins.qmd)

Tesseract is how cadjoint *implements* the components it calls — the mesher,
the tet filler, the solvers — but it is not what the interface is. The
chapter is now written around the interface, and everything that was here is
there: the packages and what each one wraps, the two mesher boundaries and
their VJP contracts, `tesseract build` and the image table, and how to serve
one in a container or on a cluster.

Read **[Plugins](plugins.qmd)**.
:::

Nothing about the Tesseract packages themselves changed. They still live in
`cadjoint/fem/tesseracts/*`, still ship `tesseract_api.py` +
`tesseract_config.yaml` + a requirements file, and are still validated by
`tests/fem/test_tesseract_packaging.py`. What changed is that cadjoint's own
code now reaches them through `cadjoint.plugins` — by *kind* rather than by
importing a module — so where each one runs is configuration. (The `native/`
Rust package that once sat beside them is
[retired](../research/native-mesher.md); there is nothing to build.)

`gradient_path="tesseract"` and `"tesseract-dc"` are unchanged and remain the
documented spellings.
